name: (Free UGC)Cinnamoroll Cloud Land
desc:
Welcome to Cinnamoroll's Cloud Land!

🏡Cozy Home: Decorate your cozy home with adorable decor!
🎨Fun Roleplay: Take on fun and interesting jobs to get amazing rewards!
✨New Friends: Meet and build lasting friendships with Cinnamoroll and his friends!
🐣 Spirits: Find the right cloud spirit that's as cute as a pet for you!
🌥Endless Exploration: Explore and discover all of the hidden surprises in Cinnamoroll's Cloud Land!

Cinnamoroll and his friends are looking forward to seeing you in the game!
